contract_text:
SUPPLIER AGREEMENT

This Supplier Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on January 1, 2027 ...

clauses.text: The Buyer shall pay all valid invoices within thirty (30) days.
The Supplier shall be liable for all direct and indirect damages without limitation.
Either party may terminate this Agreement with sixty (60) days written notice.
Confidential information shall remain protected for five years.

risks.reason: Late payment interest of 1.5% per month may exceed statutory limits.
Unlimited liability exposes the supplier to significant financial risk.
A 60-day notice period may delay operational changes.
